title: Mismatch Negativity and General Cognitive Ability - A Meta-Analysis
title_zh: 失配负性与一般认知能力——一项荟萃分析
abstract: Intelligence or general cognitive ability (GCA) is fundamental to human behavior and cognition. It impacts important life outcomes like educational success, and even health and longevity have been related to differences in GCA. Understanding the biological basis of such individual variations presents a crucial goal of neuroscience. The mismatch negativity (MMN) is an event-related brain potential that can be measured when-within a series of frequent standard stimuli, rare deviants are presented-and is suggested to reflect conscious (active) or unconscious (passive) detection processes of the brain. Importantly, variations in MMN amplitude and latency have been linked to differences in GCA. Yet findings vary considerably. This preregistered meta-analysis provides a comprehensive and structured overview of the current state of research. Following the study selection process in accordance with the PRISMA guidelines, and the rating of study design quality with the Study Design and Implementation Assessment Device for Individual Difference Research (DIAD-ID), the association between GCA and MMN amplitude and latency was examined in 645 healthy adults across 12 included studies. The estimated across-sample associations between MMN and GCA were small, but significant (MMN amplitude-GCA: r = -0.09, MMN latency-GCA: r = -0.16; p < 0.01) and moderators were identified. Between-sample heterogeneity was moderate, with no evidence of publication bias. Our findings suggest that higher cognitive ability is associated with slightly stronger and faster MMN responses. However, the low estimated across-sample effect sizes and the small number of included studies also highlight the need for more research.
abstract_zh: 智力或一般认知能力（GCA）是人类行为和认知的基础。它影响着重要的人生结局，如教育成功，甚至健康和长寿也与GCA的差异相关。理解此类个体差异的生物学基础是神经科学的重要目标之一。失配负性（MMN）是一种事件相关脑电位，可在一系列高频标准刺激中呈现稀有偏差刺激时测得，并被提示反映大脑的有意识（主动）或无意识（被动）检测过程。重要的是，MMN振幅和潜伏期的差异已与GCA差异相关联。然而，研究结果差异较大。这项预登记荟萃分析全面而系统地概述了当前研究状况。遵循PRISMA指南进行研究筛选，并利用个体差异研究的研究设计与实施评估工具（DIAD-ID）评估研究设计质量，研究了12项纳入研究中645名健康成年人GCA与MMN振幅及潜伏期的关联。估计的MMN与GCA之间的跨样本关联虽小但显著（MMN振幅–GCA：r = -0.09；MMN潜伏期–GCA：r = -0.16；p < 0.01），并识别出调节变量。样本间异质性适中，未发现出版偏倚证据。研究结果表明，较高的认知能力与略强且较快的MMN反应相关联。然而，较低的估计跨样本效应量和纳入研究数量较少也凸显了开展更多研究的必要性。
